content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [article_no], along with two [product_name] expansion modules ([article_no]) and one RTD module ([article_no]). In my setup, I use AI1, and there are no analogue inputs on the [product_name]. I downloaded an application example from [url] about wire break/short circuit evaluation for Pt100/Pt1000 sensors. When connecting a 3-wire pt100, I get correct values. However, if the connection is broken, the display shows 'short circuit' instead of 'wire break.' Could you assist in troubleshooting why this is happening? Thank you.
With the [version_no] standard, wire break and short circuit produce the same effect in monitoring, including for [version_no] FS04.
So this means the application from the website is incorrect because when the pt100 is disconnected, the message indicates a short circuit?

To my knowledge, there is no documentation on this. The series 8 [product_name] uses entirely new hardware, which brought changes regardless of whether they were intended. The analog output module can only be connected to a standard 0-10V interface. For example, connecting it to an electronic ballast with a 0-10V interface results in unreliable operation, whereas with earlier hardware ([version_no]), this was not a problem. If you want a definite answer, submitting a support request would be advisable.
Hello, It seems you may have selected the wrong AI in the example. If you choose the correct input as shown in the example, it works as described. Hope this clarifies things.
The AI selection isn't the issue. The new module in the [version_no] series produces the same result for both wire break and short circuit.
[user_name] Hello, I am also experiencing the same problem. Has anyone found a solution?

This problem cannot be solved. For the RTD modules of the [version_no], both short circuit and wire break result in the same behavior—the output is the lowest value. Therefore, errors can only be evaluated in a general way and cannot be specifically separated as either a short circuit or wire break.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have observed that with [product_name] and relevant modules, when a Pt100 sensor is disconnected, the system displays 'short circuit' rather than 'wire break.' Both faults yield identical outputs, making it impossible to tell them apart for diagnostic purposes. This behavior is not documented, nor is it reflected in sample applications provided online, leading to confusion because actual device feedback doesn't match user expectations or examples.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to accurately distinguish between short circuit and wire break conditions, as suggested by online documentation and sample applications.
